[6:14PM] #PWD #TrafficUpdate 

Heavy traffic congestion inward route from National towards Ajayi Farm via PWD, resulting from a minor accident at Ikeja Flyover, which has recently been cleared.
Smooth movement on the stretch from Ajayi Farm to Mongoro, Cement, and down to Dopemu Underneath the Bridge.
Building up of traffic approaching Dopemu Bridge.

Good traffic flow on the return journey from Dopemu Underneath the Bridge back to Ikeja, including Bolade Junction on the return route to PWD.

#FollowLASTMA

data.raw_text:
[6:47PM] #Agege #TrafficUpdate 

Busy movement on Oba Akran from Dangote U-Turn inward to Mobil Ashade and down to Akilo, due to influx of return journey traffic.
Congested traffic on Ijaye Road, both inward and outward, from Odo Eran to Oba Ogunji, resulting from traffic alternation and evening rush hour.
Busy traffic flow at Fumec inward Acme Junction and down to Metal Box, attributed to return journey influx.
Fast-paced movement at Guinness inward Akanni Doherty, connecting to Mangoro Ashade, although Ashade is experiencing busy traffic due to traffic light alternation.
Busy traffic on Capitol Road inward Oniwaya Junction, due to alternation, while Alfa Nla to Okekoto is moving at a fast pace.
Busy movement on Okekoto inward Shofunde Agbotikuyo, due to alternation, while Olufunlayo to NYSC is moving at a fast pace.
Busy traffic on Isokoko inward Total Underneath the Bridge, resulting from alternation and commuter activities, while Nitel to Oko Oba is moving at a fast pace, and Abattoir is experiencing busy traffic due to alternation.

#FollowLASTMA
